metadata_findings: The only MetadataAssociation is SCIENCE ASSOCIATED to the record itself (TOVSAMNG 02): a self-relation, which should be removed or replaced with the lineage below.
The DATA SET LANDING PAGE (https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/ges-disc-sndrsnil3smcfsp-2) is the landing page of an unrelated dataset.

The Abstract describes the analysis cycle as a "2nd order General Circulation Model (Takacs et al., 1994)", a 6-hour window and an Optimal Interpolation analysis; the README and User's Guide describe a 4th order GCM (Kalnay et al, 1983), a three-hour window and a successive correction (SCM) analysis.
A PublicationReference title is truncated: 'haracteristics of the TOVS Pathfinder Path A Dataset'.
No ATBD linked; the lineage inputs (Path-A Level 2, HIRS2/MSU Level 1b) are not CMR collections, so no PARENT or INPUT can be recorded.
Version 01 of this ShortName is still in CMR with no association to version 02.

excluded.detail: The Level 2 data were quality controlled and gridded into a Level 3 product using a simple binning and averaging technique.
Input of the Level 2 retrieval; no Pathfinder-era Level 1b collection in CMR (NCEI HIRS/MSU CDRs are later reprocessings not cited).
